paragraphs: Legal imagery is remarkably conservative. The same two objects have stood for justice in illustration for over a century, and every attempt to modernise the visual language has failed because nothing else is recognised as quickly.

The model holds 31,034 polygons and 31,954 vertices, built in quads only with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 14 maps, 3 at 4096x4096 and 11 at 2048x2048. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits legal and editorial illustration, corporate and institutional visualisation, stock and advertising imagery, film set dressing, game props and education material. On sale since 2016.

The palm is the entire product. Latex on the catching surface is deliberately soft, wears out within a season and is replaced without complaint, because grip is worth more to a keeper than durability ever will be.
